26yujr8kg50: ## The limit of 150 and collective failure
13nmvrmuwqg: Each instance of the **Windows Firewall rules** profile accepts up to **150 custom rules**. In the older Endpoint protection model, **if one rule fails, all the rules in the profile fail** and none applies, and Intune cannot say which one failed. Design consequence: split into **small coherent profiles** (for example one profile per application or function), so that one error does not invalidate the whole rule set.
1c0xmrhfuca: The firewall CSP processes rules as an "atomic block": since **Windows 11 21H2, Windows 11 22H2 and Windows 10 21H2**, application is **all or nothing** for each block. On older versions, the CSP applies the rules one by one; if it hits a problem, it **stops** applying the following rules **without undoing** those already set, which can give a **partial** deployment. On a heterogeneous fleet, do not therefore take all-or-nothing for granted.
